name: plugin-module-split
description: Split a large Claude Code or Codex plugin into a small core plus optional modules. Use for "split this plugin", "my plugin is too big", "reduce startup context", "Codex is omitting my skills", "core plus optional packs", or "publish part of my plugin separately". Covers marketplace subdirectory sourcing, the dependency field's silent-load behaviour, Codex adapter regeneration, and vendored-skill placement. Use agent-auditor to measure first and benchmark-skills to verify routing after.
